Reference / http/cache

http/cache#

A private HTTP cache around a client (RFC 9111).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let cache = MemoryHttpCache(clock: SystemClock(), maximum: 67108864);
let client = Caching(origin: HttpClient(), cache: cache, clock: SystemClock());
await client.response(Request(url: "https://example.com/logo.png"));

Description#

A private HTTP cache around a client (RFC 9111).

Only GET is answered from the cache. A fresh entry is served; a stale one is revalidated with If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since, and a 304 refreshes it. Freshness comes from max-age or Expires; there is no heuristic freshness. Other methods that succeed invalidate the entry for their URL. A body is kept only after it was read to the end.

Public API#

object Caching#

object Caching does Exchanging

Private cache decorator; returned live bodies remain lazy. Publication needs clean EOF and validated trailers, with bounded capture and no retained socket.

Caching.Caching#

Caching(origin is Exchanging, cache is ResponseCaching, clock is Timing)

Sends through origin, keeping responses in cache; clock measures age.

Caching.response#

async response(request is Request) is ClientResponse

A fresh cached response, a revalidated one, or origin's.
